title: Research model: closed vocabulary + graph builder
description: Closed thirteen-entity research vocabulary (Project, Question, Idea, Hypothesis, Model, Experiment, Run, Artifact, Observation, Claim, Finding, Decision, Source) and typed, direction-fixed relationship graph (kaya.model capability; tasks.md 1.3, 2.4). Red: unknown entity refused; unknown relationship refused; dangling reference refused; influence cycle refused. Green: graph builder consuming valid ledger events. Demoable: fixture ledger validates and resolves the full graph. Source entity schema reserves namespaced id field (file-path@commit provenance now; layer-level ids upgrade in place later). Contract tests: kaya.model scenarios execute under ah check --run-tests.
close_reason: MVP-1 implemented, verified (cargo test 128, clippy -D warnings, just ci), pipeline run complete

title: MVP-1 acceptance gate: three-question dossier test
description: MVP-1 definition of done (post-bootstrap alignment, decision 2). Running MVP-1 kaya over this repo must produce a research index + one experiment report (add-core-research-record) where each question is answerable from the dossier ALONE, with provenance, without reading raw sources: (1) Why are events not genesis envelopes? (2) What evidence supports 'adapters translate, never interpret'? (3) What is deliberately unspecified (MVP-2+ seams)? Red: three assertions, each requiring answer presence + provenance resolution via file-path@commit Source entities. Dulce-de-leche tools are second-example targets as adapters land (not part of this gate).
close_reason: MVP-1 implemented, tests 148 green, clippy clean, just ci green, tdd-ro5u pipeline complete

title: kaya.event/v0 schema + append-only JSONL ledger store
description: Event schema + append-only ledger store (kaya.event + kaya.ledger capabilities; tasks.md 1.1, 1.2, 2.2). Core event format is the closed nine-field set fixed by the kaya-event spec: id, schema, type, timestamp, actor, subject, data, provenance, artifacts — `project` is NOT an event field (project identity lives in node ids `<project>/<TYPE>/<key>` and in the ledger location). Red: parser round-trip incl. rejection of malformed events (missing timestamp, unknown schema version, missing provenance, id reuse, extra field); ledger fixtures: append-only byte check, supersede round trip, idempotent replay, digest stability, crash-tail (partial last line) recovery. Green: serde types + validator + JSONL store. Refactor: dedupe by (type, subject, provenance) per design. Demoable milestone: ledger round-trips events end-to-end (append -> replay -> stable digest). Contract tests: kaya.event + kaya.ledger scenarios execute under ah check --run-tests (archive checklist).
close_reason: MVP-1 implemented, verified (cargo test 128, clippy -D warnings, just ci), pipeline run complete
